narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a promotional piece for the WorldSkills Asia Taipei 2025 competition. It uses a lighthearted, humorous interview format between an English teacher and a skilled culinary student to highlight professional skills (fruit peeling and table service) while maintaining viewer engagement through social-media style editing and comedic interactions.
